module: Shared utilities of the minimap: world / map coordinate conversion (affine transform recomputed at each setMinimapState), clamping within the map limits (circle or square), drawing of simple shapes (circle, line, edge pointer, 50 m grid) and color palettes (Default, Monochrome, Green, Blue, Orange, Grayscale). The minimap module calls setMinimapState every frame; the other modules (roads, route, vehicles) use it to draw. A modder adding a marker on the minimap mostly uses simpleCircleWithEdgePointer and worldToMapXY.
notes: No drawing function works before the first setMinimapState (td, width, height… are nil).
The world to map matrix: x_map = x*XX + y*XYCoef + XOffset; y_map = x*YX + y*YY + YOffset; the map's Y axis is inverted.
Bug: M.centerPointer is exported but the local variable centerPointer does not exist; the field is nil.
The local function worldToMapXYInverse (world from map) is defined but never exported; mapToWorld, for its part, uses centerX/centerY and the inverse rotation.
drawEdgePointer ignores its strikeClr parameter: the outline is always white and the border clrNavBg (white). setClampToBounds does not use it either: its maxDistance parameter is unused.
Colors are color(r,g,b,a) objects with components from 0 to 255.
The color set used is always index 1 (Default): defaultStyleRoadColorSet is a local constant, not modifiable from outside.

dpi.desc: Screen scale factor of the minimap, updated by setMinimapState (1 at start).

colors.desc: Exposed colors: orange, orangeMuted, grayMuted, roadBgTransparentBlack, navBgBlack, gridWhite, navBgWhite, navFgBlue.

centerPointer.desc: Exported from a local variable that does not exist: always nil.

setMinimapState.desc: Receives from the main minimap the size, center, camera, scale, drawing object, offset, mode (circle by default or square) and dpi, then recomputes the world to map transform coefficients.

minimapMode.desc: 'circle' (default) or anything else for a square/rectangular map.

worldToMap.desc: Converts a world point to a map point (allocating version, recomputed with subtraction, division by the scale and rotation). Prefer worldToMapXY for loops.

worldToMapXYZ.desc: Converts source (world x, y) to map coordinates and writes them into target (z = 0), without allocation.

target.desc: Output vector (may be the same as source).

worldToMapXY.desc: Converts world coordinates (x, y) to map coordinates.

worldLineToMapXY.desc: Converts both ends of a world segment to map coordinates.

getWorldToMapTransform.desc: Returns the six coefficients of the world to map affine transform, to pass to the td's transformed drawing functions.

mapToWorld.desc: Converts a map point (pixels) to a world point (z = 0 before adding the camera position).

isInsideMinimapBounds.desc: Tests whether a map point is inside the map rectangle, optionally shrunk by a margin.

buffer.desc: Inner margin in pixels (0 by default).

clampToMinimapBounds.desc: Clamps pos (modified in place) within the map rectangle expanded by buffer.

setClampToBounds.desc: Brings pos (modified in place) back to the map edge (circle of radius width/2 - inset in circle mode, rectangle otherwise) while keeping the direction from the center.

inset.desc: Inset from the edge in pixels (0 by default).

returns.desc: true if the point was brought back to the edge.

simpleCircle.desc: Draws a circular marker at a world position, on the GAMEPLAY_MARKERS layer (orange with white outline by default).

simpleLine.desc: Draws a round-ended segment between two world positions, on the GAMEPLAY_MARKERS layer.

drawEdgePointer.desc: Draws a pointer on the map edge for a world position outside the map (ROUTE_POINTER layer). Draws nothing and returns false if the position is inside.

maxDistance.desc: Max distance to show the pointer (unlimited by default).

returns.desc: true if a pointer was drawn.

simpleCircleWithEdgePointer.desc: Draws an edge pointer if the position is off the map, otherwise a simple circle at that position.

simpleLineWithEdgePointer.desc: Uses the segment's midpoint: edge pointer if it is off the map, otherwise a simple line.

drawGrid.desc: Draws a background grid with a line every 50 world meters, on the BG_GRID layer, around the camera.

getStyleColorSet.desc: Returns the list of color sets (Default, Monochrome, Green, Blue, Orange, Grayscale) with color, colorLow, colorLowest, clrFocus, clrFocusMuted, gridWhite, navFg, navBg, grayMuted.

getDefaultStyleColorSet.desc: Returns the index of the default color set (always 1).

getCurrentStyleColors.desc: Returns the active color set (the default index).
